summary: This tutorial covers setting up Mozilla Thunderbird on Linux systems, specifically for Ubuntu 12.04. It explains how to download and install Thunderbird from the Ubuntu Software Center or directly from its website. The tutorial outlines the basic steps to configure Thunderbird for managing multiple email accounts, including Gmail and Yahoo. Key features discussed include organizing emails by date, sender, priority, and custom labels. For Windows users, it mentions downloading and installing Thunderbird from the official Mozilla website. The tutorial also details how to set up Thunderbird for POP3 email accounts, configuring settings such as enabling POP3 for downloading emails, logging into Gmail, and forwarding emails using the settings tab. Finally, it guides users through launching Thunderbird from the Dash Home and navigating its interface, including the main menu, folders, and email accounts panel.
